accessibility.text: The Mission:  Modernize the visual identity of a flagship national television program rooted in classical Arabic poetic and cultural tradition.
The Friction: Converting the fluid, rule-based curves of classical calligraphy into mathematically rigid 3D assets and motion graphics.
The Risk:  High-visibility regional media brand with zero room for cultural or artistic errors.
Image Credit/  Artists in Motion.   Diaa Allam
Pioneering Framework: Created a repeatable pipeline for merging traditional typography into dynamic 3D virtual studios.
Upfront Quality Gates: Enforced authenticity reviews early, freezing vector outlines with calligraphy experts before rendering to eliminate expensive re-work loops.
Technical Standardization: Set strict polygon limits and camera tracking rules to ensure zero lag or system clipping during live virtual studio playback.
